task: Deepen (flagship 7): photo-editing, X-Trans demosaic C path
errors: First pytest run used -n 4 without pytest-xdist installed (usage error); reran without it.
First C version was only 1.3x faster than numpy; profiled one band in a standalone C harness (median network 40%), fixed with unrolled vector-extension median, fused box averages, -O3: 4x.

doc_friction.issue: pyenv.py pytest numpy found /usr/bin/python3.13, but photo-editing's suite needs PYTHONPATH=src (collection fails with No module named 'shootflow' otherwise) and rawpy for the real-frame tools; neither is mentioned where the suite command is described.
Module docstring says the C and numpy paths agree 'not bit for bit' while eval/bayer-native-2026-11-15.md and its tests say bit for bit; left as is (not this run's file) but it cost a re-read.

deviations.why: Changed the numpy reference (float32 ** 4 to two squarings) instead of only adding the C path: numpy's power is CPU-dependent (SIMD), so exact agreement was otherwise impossible and the reference itself was not reproducible across machines.
deviations.did: Measured the output change on both real frames (<= 3e-7 of full scale, 162-164 dB) and documented it in the eval note.
deviations.result: C and numpy equal bit for bit on real and synthetic inputs.
